extracted.name: Blueberry Smoothie
extracted.description: This blueberry smoothie recipe is creamy, nutritious, and refreshing. Blend it up for a delicious healthy breakfast or snack!
ingredient_lines: 1¼ cups almond milk (plus more as needed)
instruction_lines: In a blender, place the blueberries, almond milk, cauliflower, raspberries, banana, almond butter, maple syrup, lemon juice, and ginger, if using.
Blend until creamy, adding more almond milk as needed to blend.
